test_module_decorator: test the @modules decorator that parametrizes PyTorch module tests over module list, dtypes, and train/eval modes
test_module_info: test the ModuleInfo class that defines module metadata including inputs function, dtypes, decorators, and skip conditions
test_module_inputs: test ModuleInput and FunctionInput classes that specify constructor args and forward pass inputs for module testing
test_module_db: test the module_db database of ModuleInfo entries covering all PyTorch NN modules with their test configurations
test_error_module_inputs: test ErrorModuleInput and ModuleErrorEnum for defining expected construction and forward errors in module tests
